title: Adversarial review kit
summary: Selects a named pass or filtered questions from the owner's bank, plans honest starting records, and fails stale hashes, absent intervals, unsupported coverage and waveform-passed listening questions.
description: This is the owner's authoritative adversarial review bank: the 1,024 questions of Appendix E of the Animation and Video Production Master Guide (10 Oct 2026), transcribed with the owner's exact text, ids, filters and pass membership. Another builder in this catalogue (harness_kit) independently wrote a different 1,024-question bank; it is not this set and does not override it. Standard library only. Reads the review_bank_<area> questions.json files and the nine named passes (passes.json, shipped here).

side_effects: reads question banks and result files; hashes the target file

evidence_notes: Focused tested in the guide's sense: the shipped pytest suite (positive, boundary and negative cases, including the guide's own record) passes with Python 3 in this repository. It is a new implementation of the guide's stated rules, not the source bank's 39-test validator suite, and has not been used on a real film review.
